_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

open_questions: Value of one reward point (checked again 2026-11-07): no RBL document states it for iGlobe. Not on the iGlobe product page (all three tabs), the iGlobe T&C (3.3 and 3.4), the SOC, the MITC, the Cardmember Agreement, the Miles Transfer T&C (only 4 points = 1 mile), the Rewards Programme T&C (RWD 4.1 refers to "the value applicable to the product specific value proposition" without a number, and RWD 3.1 says accrual varies by card) or the public part of rblrewards.rbl.bank.in (FAQs). The redemption screens sit behind the rewards login, which was not opened. point_value_inr_baseline, effective_base_return_percent and the milestone rupee values are therefore null, as the brief requires. A person with an iGlobe login can read the per-point value off the portal.

Network (resolved 2026-11-07): RBL's own network availability guide (issuer page, undated) ticks "iGlobe Credit Card" for MasterCard only, not Visa or RuPay. That agrees with the iGlobe T&C, whose milestone clause names "MasterCard" as the association (T&C 3.3 and 3.4) and whose golf and lounge clauses name Mastercard. The card art shows no network mark and the product page says the lounge programme is "offered by MasterCard/Visa"; the guide is preferred because it is the issuer's card-by-card statement.

Redemption fee: the Rewards Programme T&C (RWD 4.3.1(b)(ii), undated page) lists iGlobe among the cards exempt from the INR 99 + GST redemption fee, but the exempt lists in the SOC (4 Jun 2026) and MITC (29 Oct 2026) name Lumiere, Nova, Insignia, Insignia Prime, World Xclusive, Apex, Aspire, Signature, IRCTC and IOCL and not iGlobe. The RWD exemption is stored (redemption_fee_inr 0) because it is the only document that names the card; RWD cannot be dated, so it cannot be said which is newer.
Reward point expiry: the iGlobe T&C is silent. 24 months is the Rewards Programme T&C rule (RWD 5.1), which exempts only the Insignia Preferred card.
Lounge count: the T&C says Priority Pass access to "1700+" lounges, the product page says "1,400+".
Milestone credit time: the T&C says within 30 days of crossing the threshold in one clause and "within days" in another; the page says 45 days.
The additional 10,000 points at ₹8 lakh reads as in addition to the 10,000 at ₹5 lakh; the T&C wording ("additional") does not say whether the two tiers are cumulative.

Application route: the iGlobe product page says "To apply for RBL Bank iGlobe Credit Card, visit your nearest branch or reach out to your Relationship Manager" and the card list shows only "Know more", not "Apply Now". That is an offline application route for NRIs, so application_mode stays open.
Insignia Preferred Banking customers pay NIL; the draft stores the standard ₹3,000.

Finance charge: MITC says "up to 3.99% per month (47.88% a year)" for these cards and then lists bureau-score bands (above 775: 3.35% a month; 725-775: 3.85%; below 725: 3.99%). The draft stores the 3.99% maximum.
notes: Rewards: 5 points per ₹100 on domestic and 10 per ₹100 on international purchases. Points earned in a month are credited within 45 days of settlement (T&C 3.3).
Forex markup 1.5% (SOC; MITC; T&C 3.2). Fuel surcharge waiver 1% on ₹500-₹4,000 fuel purchases, up to ₹250 a calendar month; the surcharge is 1% of the transaction (T&C 3.5).
Joining fee is NIL (MITC); the first-year fee is stored as the annual fee.
Add-on cards are NIL (MITC "Insignia Credit Card & iGlobe Credit Card: Nil").
